entries.title: Exodus 37:1
segments: And Bezaleel made the ark [of] acacia-wood: two cubits and a half long, and a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

entries.title: Exodus 37:2
segments: And he overlaid it [with] pure gold inside and out, and made a crown of gold around it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:3
segments: And he cast four rings of gold for it, for the corners of it, even two rings on the one side of it and two rings on the other side of it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:4
segments: And he made staves [of] acacia-wood and overlaid them [with] gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:5
segments: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, in order to bear the ark.

entries.title: Exodus 37:6
segments: And he made the mercy-seat [of] pure gold. Two cubits and a half long, and one cubit and a half wide.

entries.title: Exodus 37:7
segments: And he made two cherubs [of] gold on the two ends of the mercy-seat. He made them of beaten work,

entries.title: Exodus 37:8
segments: one cherub here at one end, and one cherub there at the [other] end. He made the cherubs out of the mercy-seat on the two ends of it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:9
segments: And the cherubs were spreading out [their] wings above, covering the mercy-seat [with] their wings, their faces each toward the other. The faces of the cherubs were toward the mercy-seat.

entries.title: Exodus 37:10
segments: And he made the table [of] acacia-wood. Two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

entries.title: Exodus 37:11
segments: And he overlaid it [with] pure gold, and made for it a crown of gold all around.

entries.title: Exodus 37:12
segments: Also he made for it a border all around, of a hand's breadth. And he made a crown of gold for the border of it all around.

entries.title: Exodus 37:13
segments: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that [were] in the four feet of it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:14
segments: The rings were near the border, the housings for the staves to carry the table.

entries.title: Exodus 37:15
segments: And he made the staves [of] acacia-wood, and overlaid them [with] gold, to carry the table.

entries.title: Exodus 37:16
segments: And he made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes and its spoons, and its bowls, and its pitchers by which a drink offering is made, [of] pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:17
segments: And he made the lampstand [of] pure gold. He made the lampstand [of] beaten work; its shaft and its branch, its cups, its knobs, and its blossoms, were of the same.

entries.title: Exodus 37:18
segments: And six branches went out of the sides of it; three branches of the lampstand out of the one side of it, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:19
segments: Three almond-like cups [were] on the one branch, a knob and a blossom; and three almond-like cups on the one branch, a knob and a blossom. So throughout the six branches going out of the lampstand.

entries.title: Exodus 37:20
segments: And on the lampstand [were] four almond-like cups, its knobs and its blossoms.

entries.title: Exodus 37:21
segments: And a knob was under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, to the six branches going out of it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:22
segments: Their knobs and their branches were of the same; all of it was one beaten work [of] pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:23
segments: And he made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-dishes, [of] pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:24
segments: He made it of a talent [of] pure gold, and all the vessels of it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:25
segments: And he made the incense altar [of] acacia-wood. Its length was a cubit, and its breadth a cubit, square. And its height was two cubits. Its horns were of the same.

entries.title: Exodus 37:26
segments: And he overlaid it [with] pure gold, the top of it and the sides of it all around, and the horns of it. Also he made for it a crown of gold all around.

entries.title: Exodus 37:27
segments: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown of it, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides of it, to be places for the staves to bear it with.

entries.title: Exodus 37:28
segments: And he made the staves [of] acacia-wood, and overlaid them [with] gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:29
segments: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, the work of the perfumer.
